statement: For the SAME trace-preserving physical perturbation, sum_Z N_Z*(I)=0, center local HP pieces by M_Z*(O)=N_Z*(O)-{N_Z*(I),O}/2. The total is unchanged, supports stay local and cb norms grow by at most two. A fixed structural-cone derivative of C_delta^-1 M_Z* C_delta vanishes at delta=0; integration and POSITIVE congruence pullback earn +/-N*G_delta<=C delta_A eta N G_delta. The source/barrier ratio becomes O(epsilon²+eta) instead of O(epsilon²+eta/delta_A). Bath-only pieces must be separately identity-annihilating or consistently included in the SAME zero-total cancellation; no uncontrolled nonunital/unbounded bath term can be omitted. Individual centered pieces need not be CP, and the nonzero-delta transformed map is not claimed unital.
